correctness.rationale: For all even m≥2, the transition kernel reduces exactly to a two-hub agreement indicator and the leaf count; independent fair coin ties yield Bin(m,1/2), the middle-count event gives geometric waiting, and binomial symmetry yields terminal outcomes. The complete proof establishes every stated probability, generating function and all cases including terminal time zero. Independent standard-library rational Markov-chain verification passed 480 tests at m=2,4,6,8. Tests alone are not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: On the natural triangle-book family of social networks, the exact three-class absorbing structure for every initial condition, sharp initial-state dependent entrance-time law, and asymptotic one-half nonconsensus probability are structural results beyond finite enumeration, revealing that arbitrarily high triangle clustering need not eliminate persistent two-cycle polarization under independent-tie synchronous majority.
